AIM INTERNATIONAL

MAINTENANCE & CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT

{{ row("Project", doc.contract_title) }}{{ row("Location", doc.project_location) }}{{ row("Contract Date", d(doc.contract_date)) }}

This Agreement is made between AIM International, P.O. Box 21171–00505, Nairobi (hereinafter referred to as the Client), on the first part, and {{ sup.supplier_name if sup else "______________________" }}, Nairobi (hereinafter referred to as the Contractor/Service Provider), on the second part.

1. Scope of Work

The Contractor agrees to undertake and complete the following works:

{{ doc.scope_of_work or "" }}

Permits & Regulatory Compliance. Obtain a Renovation Permit from Nairobi County as required for the works described above, and ensure all works comply with local building codes, environmental regulations, and safety standards.

Waste disposal. The Contractor shall collect, sort (where applicable), remove, and properly dispose of all debris, construction waste, excavated soil, damaged materials, waste water, and packaging at licensed and legally approved waste disposal sites. The Client shall be responsible for all costs related to waste handling, transport, and dumping unless otherwise stated in writing.

The Contractor confirms acceptance of the project scope upon signing this Agreement.

2. Project Duration

The project timeline shall be determined based on the scope of works and mutually agreed upon by both parties before commencement. Any extension must also be mutually agreed in writing. The project will be completed in {{ doc.duration_days or "____" }} working days at most.

3. Project Location and Work Schedule

Project Location: {{ doc.project_location or "" }}. A detailed workflow and sequence of activities shall be jointly developed and agreed upon prior to mobilization.

4. Project Cost

{{ row("Total Cost VAT Inclusive (KES)", money(doc.contract_value)) }} {{ row("Deposit (KES)", money(doc.deposit_amount)) }} {{ row("Materials cost (KES)", money(doc.materials_cost)) }} {{ row("Labour cost (KES)", money(doc.labour_cost)) }} {{ row("Balance payable after work completion (KES)", money(doc.balance_payable)) }}

5. Payment Terms

The payment structure shall be agreed upon at project inception. All payments shall be based on completed milestones or deliverables mutually defined by the Client and Contractor. (i) Deposit of {{ doc.deposit_percent or 0 }}% to be paid upfront; (ii) {{ 100 - (doc.deposit_percent or 0) }}% after work completion.

6. Project Changes / Variations

Any unforeseen work, additional tasks, or modifications requested by either party must be documented and agreed upon prior to execution. Variation approvals must be signed by both parties.

7. Terms and Conditions

7.1 Materials and Procurement. All materials shall meet approved standards and specifications and be sourced from reliable suppliers acceptable to the Client. If the Client funds materials upfront, the Contractor shall provide valid invoices before purchase. Unused materials shall be recorded and handed over during the post-inspection meeting. Off-cuts, wood, or reusable debris shall be collected and stored in designated areas as directed by the Client.

7.2 Inspection Procedures. Pre-inspection: a joint inspection shall identify project needs, and a written Work Order{% if doc.facilities_work_order %} ({{ doc.facilities_work_order }}){% endif %} shall be attached to this contract. Ongoing: the Client or their representative shall monitor progress and compliance. Post-inspection: conducted on completion before final payment; both parties must confirm quality of workmanship, materials used, and compliance with specifications. Safety: all work shall follow ABS safety guidelines and relevant Kenyan regulations.

7.3 Repeat Works. If repeat work is required due to the Contractor's fault, the Contractor bears all costs. If it is due to Client-initiated changes or external factors, the Client bears the costs.

7.4 Project Handover. Handover shall occur only after successful post-inspection and mutual agreement that all works have been completed satisfactorily.

7.5 Warranty. The Contractor shall provide a written warranty covering workmanship and structural integrity for an agreed period after handover{% if doc.warranty_period %}: {{ doc.warranty_period }}{% endif %}.

7.6 Competence / Prior Work. The Contractor shall, upon request, provide references or evidence of prior similar work demonstrating competence.

7.7 Project Cancellation or Termination. Reasons for termination shall be discussed and mutually agreed upon by both parties. Termination terms (notice period, liabilities, and payments for completed work) shall be documented in writing.

8. Dispute Resolution

Disputes may arise from disagreements on repeat works, quality concerns, delays, or any party feeling aggrieved. Resolution steps: 1. Negotiation, to resolve issues amicably. 2. Mediation by a neutral mediator acceptable to both parties if negotiation fails. 3. Arbitration or legal action under Kenyan law if mediation fails.
